Our Technology

Reaction Viora RF Tightening in Bangalore

Reaction Viora RF tightening is a radiofrequency-based technology considered in selected skin-firming and body-contouring plans. The appropriate approach depends on the treatment area, skin quality, medical suitability and the outcome being discussed.

Learn How It Works

What Is Reaction Viora RF Tightening?

Radiofrequency treatment delivers controlled energy to selected tissue layers as part of a non-surgical treatment plan. It may be considered for concerns related to skin firmness and contour refinement when clinically appropriate.

How Is It Different From Other Approaches?

RF tightening is not a surgical substitute for every concern. During consultation, the clinician considers the degree of laxity, the condition of the skin, the area being treated and whether a non-surgical plan is appropriate.

Why a Personalised Assessment Matters

Technology is selected around the individual concern, not the device alone. The consultation considers the area being treated, clinical history, suitability, treatment goals, available alternatives and the practical recovery or session plan.

Potential Benefits of a Planned Approach

Non-surgical treatment planning is considered as part of a clinician-led Reaction Viora RF Tightening discussion, based on the individual concern and the treatment plan advised.

  • Non-surgical treatment planning

  • Area-specific assessment

  • Session-based treatment approach

  • Progress review where appropriate

Our Process

How Reaction Viora RF Tightening Planning Works

The clinician assesses the concern, treatment area, skin quality and relevant medical history.

The appropriate pathway is discussed, including whether another technology or a surgical consultation may be more suitable.

Where a session plan is advised, its likely frequency and review points are explained.

Treatment is delivered according to the plan agreed after clinical assessment.

Skincare, sun protection, recovery and review requirements are explained.

Who May Be Assessed?

  • Selected skin-firmness concerns

  • Contour-refinement concerns

  • Adults exploring a non-surgical approach

It may be considered for adults seeking consultation for selected skin-firmness or contour-refinement concerns. The clinician will discuss whether RF treatment, another non-surgical approach or a surgical consultation is more appropriate.

Results, Recovery and Realistic Expectations

The number and frequency of sessions, the response observed and the aftercare advice vary. Your clinician will explain realistic expectations and any relevant treatment limitations before you decide.
